item.title: Poaching Gang busted in Odisha's Similipal forest; 5 held with weapons and wildlife products
item.description: Baripada: Forest officials have arrested five members of a poaching gang operating inside the Similipal forest. A country-made gun, several traps and a large quantity of dry wild meat were recovered from them. The arrested men are Barsing Ho (33), Charan Ho (43), Chhale Ho (23), Sagar Ho (29) and Sukra Ho (32). All are residents of Jadida village under Khunta police limits in Mayurbhanj district. item.title: Indian Railways 2nd largest freight carrying rail network in world: Minister
item.description: New Delhi: The government has informed that freight loading increased from 1,233 million tonnes (MT) in 2020-21 to 1,617 MT in 2024-25, making Indian Railways second largest freight carrying Railways in the world. To keep the freight rate competitive, the freight rates have not been revised since 2018 despite increase in input cost over the years, according to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. item.title: Odisha explosives loot case: NIA files charge sheet, names 11 Maoists
item.description: New Delhi: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Thursday has chargesheeted 11 accused in a case involving the loot of around 4,000 kg of explosives by armed cadres of the CPI (Maoist) terror organisation during transportation to a stone quarry in Odisha’s Rourkela district. According to a statement issued by the NIA, all 11 accused have been charged under various sections of the UA(P) Act, BNSS, Arms Act and the Explosive Substances Act. item.title: IndiGo Board to bring in external experts to review flight disruptions: Chairman Vikram Singh Mehta
item.description: New Delhi: IndiGo Chairman Vikram Singh Mehta on Thursday said that the airline’s Board will bring in external technical experts to work with the management and identify the root causes behind last week’s massive flight disruptions. In a detailed statement, Mehta said the experts will help ensure that such large-scale operational failures never happen again.
